queries_run: Corning distribution channel disruption OR shift 2026
GLW Corning business model transition subscription OR platform 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 載明 Life Sciences 面臨大型經銷商向後整合或推出自有品牌產品的競爭（通路端競爭壓力的書面揭露）；搜尋未見 2026 年訂閱化、D2C 或平台化的通路結構轉變報導。
findings.excerpt: Corning also faces competition from large distributors that have pursued backward integration or introduced private label products.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 三次搜尋未發現 Corning 訂閱化／D2C／通路去中介的來源；Springboard 的 Market-Access Platforms 為產品市場策略，非通路轉型，未列為 finding。
